prompt: Symbol-only hospitality app logo. Bold minimal geometry, rounded precision, warm ochre gold #BF944B, transparent alpha background, clear at 24px on off-white #FAFAF8 and charcoal #282828. No text, letters, numbers, enclosing tile, gradients, texture, outlines, glow, shadows or 3D.

concepts.name: Open welcome
concepts.concept: A single bold rounded arch framing one offset open door leaf; asymmetrical welcoming entrance, broad negative space.

concepts.name: Room key
concepts.concept: An elegant abstract room key: circular bow with a square negative-space center, short sturdy stem and one broad tooth; balanced compact diagonal silhouette, no letters.

concepts.name: Connected rooms
concepts.concept: Four rounded room tiles in a compact pinwheel, linked by a clear central negative-space courtyard. Architectural hospitality organization.

concepts.name: Hospitality spark
concepts.concept: A distinctive four-point hospitality star built from four soft geometric petals with a small diamond-shaped transparent center. Friendly precision and attentive service.

concepts.name: Seamless stay
concepts.concept: Two interlocking rounded loops forming a compact balanced knot, suggesting effortless connected hotel operations; clean over-under negative-space cuts, no infinity symbol.

concepts.name: Shelter
concepts.concept: A refined shelter emblem: a single sweeping rounded canopy above two balanced short pillars, with a broad welcoming open center. Distinctive low wide architectural silhouette, not a literal house or doorway arch.

concepts.name: Guest orbit
concepts.concept: Three broad rounded capsule forms curving around a single circular central guest dot, a compact dynamic hospitality orbit. Simple, friendly, carefully spaced, no fine lines.

concepts.name: Courtyard compass
concepts.concept: A geometric boutique-hotel courtyard emblem: four L-shaped corner forms arranged with rotational symmetry around a generous transparent square courtyard, compact square footprint.

concepts.name: Welcome wings
concepts.concept: Two broad stylized wing or leaf forms opening upwards from one short central base, expressing welcoming care and growth; symmetrical abstract hospitality gesture, no bird details, no literal hands.

concepts.name: Rising ribbon
concepts.concept: A bold single folded ribbon with two broad ascending rounded steps, compact abstract architectural silhouette expressing smooth organized progress. No arrowhead, no letter shape, no chart axes.
